days.title: Water Sources and Panoramic Views
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: lago di Piediluco
stops.detail: Near the village of Marmore, the Velino flows out of Lake Piediluco and plunges into the underlying Nera gorge, forming the waterfalls.

stops.name: Torreorsina
stops.detail: A panoramic view of the waterfall can be admired from the medieval village of Torreorsina, the only town in the Valnerina that directly overlooks it.

stops.name: belvedere inferiore

stops.name: Grotte
stops.detail: Some caves can be visited and represent a still little-known aspect of the Marmore Falls.

stops.name: Centro di Educazione Ambientale
stops.detail: The Marmore Falls area is equipped with visiting trails, an Environmental Education Centre, and services.
